engram.cli_mode: real binary built from source_revision with isolated ENGRAM_DATA_DIR

prompts.text: Without modifying files, explain how this repository expects an agent to recall durable project knowledge before starting work. Name any project command you actually use.
Without modifying files, identify the smallest documentation change that would teach contributors to keep command examples deterministic. Explain where it belongs and what verification you would run.

Without modifying files, diagnose why the durable fact "the evaluation color pair is cobalt maple" might be missing from a later coding session. Use available project tooling if it can materially change the diagnosis.
Report the current Git branch and whether the worktree is clean. Do not modify files.
Recall the stored evaluation color pair for this project. Use the repository's normal project-memory workflow if one is available, then answer with the color pair. Do not modify files.

Preserve this durable project preference using the repository's normal project-memory workflow if one is available: evaluation fixtures must use deterministic examples tagged EVAL-PRESERVE-731. Do not edit repository files.

stopping_rule: Run every planned cell once; retain integration failures and do not replace outcomes.
exclusions: Exclude a cell only when pre-run contract, runtime, fixture, skill-inventory, or treatment-visibility verification fails before model execution.
omissions: Retain Codex process, bounded-event, final-message, shim-log, and parse failures as named omissions; never reinterpret missing evidence as semantic non-invocation.

retention.raw_evidence: Bounded in memory or disposable per-cell storage and removed immediately after classification.
retention.bounded_events: Versioned with the frozen study and limited to protocol identities, canonical event classifications, omissions, and deviations.
